1	---
     2	name: frontend-design
     3	description: Expert frontend design guidelines for creating beautiful, modern UIs. Use when building landing pages, dashboards, or any user interface.
     4	metadata: {"clawdbot":{"emoji":"🎨"}}
     5	---
     6	
     7	# Frontend Design Skill
     8	
     9	Use this skill when creating UI components, landing pages, dashboards, or any frontend design work.
    10	
    11	## Design Workflow
    12	
    13	Follow this structured approach for UI design:
    14	
    15	1. **Layout Design** — Think through component structure, create ASCII wireframes
    16	2. **Theme Design** — Define colors, fonts, spacing, shadows
    17	3. **Animation Design** — Plan micro-interactions and transitions
    18	4. **Implementation** — Generate the actual code
    19	
    20	### 1. Layout Design
    21	
    22	Before coding, sketch the layout in ASCII format:
    23	
    24	```
    25	┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
    26	│         HEADER / NAV BAR            │
    27	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    28	│                                     │
    29	│            HERO SECTION             │
    30	│         (Title + CTA)               │
    31	│                                     │
    32	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    33	│   FEATURE   │  FEATURE  │  FEATURE  │
    34	│     CARD    │   CARD    │   CARD    │
    35	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    36	│            FOOTER                   │
    37	└─────────────────────────────────────┘
    38	```
    39	
    40	### 2. Theme Guidelines
    41	
    42	**Color Rules:**
    43	- NEVER use generic bootstrap-style blue (#007bff) — it looks dated
    44	- Prefer oklch() for modern color definitions
    45	- Use semantic color variables (--primary, --secondary, --muted, etc.)
    46	- Consider both light and dark mode from the start
    47	
    48	**Font Selection (Google Fonts):**
    49	```
    50	Sans-serif: Inter, Roboto, Poppins, Montserrat, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, Space Grotesk
    51	Monospace: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Source Code Pro, IBM Plex Mono, Space Mono, Geist Mono
    52	Serif: Merriweather, Playfair Display, Lora, Source Serif Pro, Libre Baskerville
    53	Display: Architects Daughter, Oxanium
    54	```
    55	
    56	**Spacing & Shadows:**
    57	- Use consistent spacing scale (0.25rem base)
    58	- Shadows should be subtle — avoid heavy drop shadows
    59	- Consider using oklch() for shadow colors too
    60	
    61	### 3. Theme Patterns
    62	
    63	**Modern Dark Mode (Vercel/Linear style):**
    64	```css
    65	:root {
    66	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    67	  --foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0);
    68	  --primary: oklch(0.205 0 0);
    69	  --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0);
    70	  --secondary: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    71	  --muted: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    72	  --muted-foreground: oklch(0.556 0 0);
    73	  --border: oklch(0.922 0 0);
    74	  --radius: 0.625rem;
    75	  --font-sans: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
    76	}
    77	```
    78	
    79	**Neo-Brutalism (90s web revival):**
    80	```css
    81	:root {
    82	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    83	  --foreground: oklch(0 0 0);
    84	  --primary: oklch(0.649 0.237 26.97);
    85	  --secondary: oklch(0.968 0.211 109.77);
    86	  --accent: oklch(0.564 0.241 260.82);
    87	  --border: oklch(0 0 0);
    88	  --radius: 0px;
    89	  --shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px hsl(0 0% 0%);
    90	  --font-sans: DM Sans, sans-serif;
    91	  --font-mono: Space Mono, monospace;
    92	}
    93	```
    94	
    95	**Glassmorphism:**
    96	```css
    97	.glass {
    98	  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    99	  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
   100	  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
   101	  border-radius: 1rem;
   102	}
   103	```
   104	
   105	### 4. Animation Guidelines
   106	
   107	**Micro-syntax for planning:**
   108	```
   109	button: 150ms [S1→0.95→1] press
   110	hover: 200ms [Y0→-2, shadow↗]
   111	fadeIn: 400ms ease-out [Y+20→0, α0→1]
   112	slideIn: 350ms ease-out [X-100→0, α0→1]
   113	bounce: 600ms [S0.95→1.05→1]
   114	```
   115	
   116	**Common patterns:**
   117	- Entry animations: 300-500ms, ease-out
   118	- Hover states: 150-200ms
   119	- Button press: 100-150ms
   120	- Page transitions: 300-400ms
   121	
   122	### 5. Implementation Rules
   123	
   124	**Tailwind CSS:**
   125	```html
   126	<!-- Import via CDN for prototypes -->
   127	<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
   128	```
   129	
   130	**Flowbite (component library):**
   131	```html
   132	<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
   133	<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.js"></script>
   134	```
   135	
   136	**Icons (Lucide):**
   137	```html
   138	<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>
   139	<script>lucide.createIcons();</script>
   140	```
   141	
   142	**Images:**
   143	- Use real placeholder services: Unsplash, placehold.co
   144	- Never make up image URLs
   145	- Example: `https://images.unsplash.com/photo-xxx?w=800&h=600`
   146	
   147	### 6. Responsive Design
   148	
   149	Always design mobile-first and responsive:
   150	
   151	```css
   152	/* Mobile first */
   153	.container { padding: 1rem; }
   154	
   155	/* Tablet */
   156	@media (min-width: 768px) {
   157	  .container { padding: 2rem; }
   158	}
   159	
   160	/* Desktop */
   161	@media (min-width: 1024px) {
   162	  .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
   163	}
   164	```
   165	
   166	### 7. Accessibility
   167	
   168	- Use semantic HTML (header, main, nav, section, article)
   169	- Include proper heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3)
   170	- Add aria-labels to interactive elements
   171	- Ensure sufficient color contrast (4.5:1 minimum)
   172	- Support keyboard navigation
   173	
   174	### 8. Component Design Tips
   175	
   176	**Cards:**
   177	- Subtle shadows, not heavy drop shadows
   178	- Consistent padding (p-4 to p-6)
   179	- Hover state: slight lift + shadow increase
   180	
   181	**Buttons:**
   182	- Clear visual hierarchy (primary, secondary, ghost)
   183	- Adequate touch targets (min 44x44px)
   184	- Loading and disabled states
   185	
   186	**Forms:**
   187	- Clear labels above inputs
   188	- Visible focus states
   189	- Inline validation feedback
   190	- Adequate spacing between fields
   191	
   192	**Navigation:**
   193	- Sticky header for long pages
   194	- Clear active state indication
   195	- Mobile-friendly hamburger menu
   196	
   197	---
   198	
   199	## Quick Reference
   200	
   201	| Element | Recommendation |
   202	|---------|---------------|
   203	| Primary font | Inter, Outfit, DM Sans |
   204	| Code font | JetBrains Mono, Fira Code |
   205	| Border radius | 0.5rem - 1rem (modern), 0 (brutalist) |
   206	| Shadow | Subtle, 1-2 layers max |
   207	| Spacing | 4px base unit (0.25rem) |
   208	| Animation | 150-400ms, ease-out |
   209	| Colors | oklch() for modern, avoid generic blue |
   210	
   211	---
   212	
   213	*Based on SuperDesign patterns — https://superdesign.dev*

1	# Global Aid Alliance — Together We Respond
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	Global Aid Alliance is a humanitarian nonprofit organization dedicated to disaster relief, emergency assistance, and community resilience worldwide. Founded in 1947, the organization mobilizes volunteers, donors, and partners to deliver critical aid when and where it's needed most. Our tone is professional yet warm — conveying urgency without despair, and hope grounded in action.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: #C41E3A (primary red), #1B3A5C (navy blue), #FFFFFF (white)
     7	
     8	## Header Navigation
     9	- About Us
    10	- Disaster Relief
    11	- Programs & Services
    12	- Volunteer
    13	- Find Local Chapter
    14	- Donate (button, primary red)
    15	
    16	Utility links: Sign In · Contact Us · Español
    17	
    18	## Hero Content
    19	Title: "When Disaster Strikes, We're There"
    20	Subtitle: "From hurricanes and wildfires to global health emergencies, Global Aid Alliance delivers immediate relief and long-term recovery support to communities in crisis."
    21	CTA Primary: "Donate Now"
    22	CTA Secondary: "Become a Volunteer"
    23	
    24	## Mission Statement
    25	**Our Mission:** Global Aid Alliance prevents and alleviates human suffering in the face of emergencies by mobilizing the power of volunteers and the generosity of donors.
    26	
    27	We are guided by the fundamental principles of humanity, impartiality, and neutrality. Every day, our teams work across borders and boundaries to ensure that help reaches those who need it most — regardless of race, religion, nationality, or political affiliation. From the first hours of a disaster to the years of recovery that follow, we stand with affected communities every step of the way.
    28	
    29	## Impact Statistics
    30	- **12 million** people assisted annually
    31	- **50,000 volunteers** active across our network
    32	- **190 countries** where we've provided aid
    33	- **$850 million raised** in the last fiscal year
    34	
    35	These figures represent real lives changed — families sheltered after storms, blood delivered to hospitals, and communities rebuilt stronger than before.
    36	
    37	## Programs and Services
    38	- **Disaster Relief** — Rapid deployment of emergency shelter, food, water, and medical supplies to communities affected by natural disasters and conflict. Our response teams are on the ground within 24 hours.
    39	- **Blood Donation** — Operating one of the largest blood collection networks, we supply approximately 40% of the nation's blood and blood products to hospitals and medical facilities.
    40	- **Emergency Preparedness** — Training individuals, families, and organizations to prepare for and respond to emergencies through workshops, certification courses, and community drills.
    41	- **International Humanitarian Aid** — Partnering with a global network of humanitarian organizations to deliver relief and recovery programs in conflict zones and disaster-affected regions worldwide.
    42	- **Community Health** — Providing health and safety education, disease prevention programs, and support services to underserved communities, including mental health resources for disaster survivors.
    43	
    44	## Get Involved
    45	**Volunteer With Us**
    46	Join over 50,000 volunteers who give their time and skills to help people in need. Whether you can commit a few hours a month or deploy to a disaster zone, there's a role for you.
    47	CTA: "Find Volunteer Opportunities"
    48	
    49	**Start a Fundraiser**
    50	Rally your community, workplace, or school to raise funds for disaster relief. We provide toolkits and support to help you make the biggest impact.
    51	CTA: "Start Your Fundraiser"
    52	
    53	**Give Blood**
    54	Every two seconds, someone in the country needs blood. Schedule an appointment at a blood drive near you and help save lives.
    55	CTA: "Find a Blood Drive"
    56	
    57	## Latest News
    58	- **Hurricane Response Update** — Global Aid Alliance teams are providing shelter and supplies to over 15,000 families displaced by Hurricane Marlena along the Gulf Coast. Relief operations are ongoing across 12 counties.
    59	- **Wildfire Relief Efforts** — Emergency shelters have been opened in three western states as crews battle record-breaking wildfires. Volunteers are distributing meals, water, and comfort kits to evacuees.
    60	- **Blood Drive Campaign** — Our summer blood drive campaign has collected over 120,000 units so far, but hospitals still face critical shortages. New donation sites have been added nationwide.
    61	- **Volunteer Spotlight** — Meet Daniela Torres, a disaster response volunteer who has deployed to seven emergencies in three years. Her story of service inspires communities across the country.
    62	
    63	## Donate Call-to-Action
    64	Title: "Your Gift Makes a Difference"
    65	Body: "A donation of any size helps us respond to disasters, train volunteers, and support communities in crisis. 91 cents of every dollar goes directly to humanitarian services."
    66	
    67	| Amount | Impact |
    68	|--------|--------|
    69	| $25 | Provides 5 emergency blankets for displaced families |
    70	| $50 | Supplies a family with food and water for one week |
    71	| $100 | Funds emergency shelter materials for a household |
    72	| $250 | Equips a volunteer with disaster response training |
    73	| Custom | Every dollar counts toward saving lives |
    74	
    75	CTA: "Donate Now"
    76	
    77	## Footer Navigation
    78	Programs: Disaster Relief · Blood Donation · Emergency Preparedness · International Aid · Community Health
    79	Get Involved: Volunteer · Donate · Start a Fundraiser · Corporate Partnerships
    80	About: Our Mission · Leadership · Financials · Careers · Press Room
    81	Support: Contact Us · FAQs · Find Local Chapter · Privacy Policy · Terms of Service
    82

    84	
    85	Social: Facebook · X (Twitter) · Instagram · LinkedIn · YouTube

steps.message:
The Global Aid Alliance single-page website has been built and saved to `/app/output/index.html`. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

### Structure (9 sections)
1. **Header** — Sticky navigation with logo, desktop nav links, utility links (Sign In, Contact Us, Español), and Donate button
2. **Hero** — Full-width section with gradient overlay, headline, subtitle, and two CTAs (Donate Now + Become a Volunteer)
3. **Mission** — Centered mission statement with brand principles
4. **Impact Stats** — 4 animated counters (12M people, 50K volunteers, 190 countries, $850M raised) with scroll-triggered animation
5. **Programs** — 5-item accordion (Disaster Relief, Blood Donation, Emergency Preparedness, International Humanitarian Aid, Community Health) with smooth expand/collapse
6. **Get Involved** — 3-column card grid for Volunteer, Fundraiser, and Blood Drive
7. **News** — 4-card carousel with next/previous navigation, responsive (1/2/3 visible cards)
8. **Donate CTA** — Amount selection grid with impact descriptions
9. **Footer** — 5-column layout with Programs, Get Involved, About, Support, social icons, and nonprofit tax info

### Interactions
- **Donate Modal** — Opens from hero/CTA/footer with amount selection and custom input
- **Mobile Menu** — Hamburger-triggered slide-out drawer with backdrop
- **Program Accordion** — Expand/collapse with smooth height transitions
- **News Carousel** — Functional prev/next navigation, responsive breakpoints
- **Animated Counters** — Scroll-triggered count-up with easing
- **Scroll Reveal** — Elements fade in as they enter viewport

### Design System
- **Colors**: Brand red (#C41E3A), navy (#1B3A5C), cream (#F9F7F4), warm grays
- **Typography**: Inter font, clear hierarchy
- **Responsive**: Mobile-first with sm/md/lg breakpoints
- **Accessibility**: Semantic HTML, ARIA labels, focus-visible states, keyboard support (Escape closes modals/menus)
- **Images**: Real Unsplash photos with descriptive alt text
